scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix server && npm run check --prefix server/client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix server/client
scripts.ci:install: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix server/client
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && npm audit --prefix server && npm audit --prefix server/client
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit:all
